title: Figure 59: Comparison of typical radar cross sections in square meters
description: Horizontal log-scale bar chart titled "Comparison of Typical Radar Cross Sections in Square Meters" spanning .0001 to 100,000 m² at X-band, placing insects, birds, cruise missile, fighter, light ground vehicle, tank/armored vehicle, bomber, surface ship and aircraft carrier along the scale. The caption reads "Figure 59. Radar Cross Section Comparison (Aerospaceweb.org, 2010)." Surrounding text gives the dBsm conversion equation and introduces a 300 MHz RCS analysis of a 10 m UAP sphere with a 1 m dielectric coating.
